name: tutorial
setup: A first hour with Charter for one new player. You found your own faction, raise a keep at the emerald pillar, stock its granary and claim land. Brinewatch, a small rival with a nearly empty granary, holds a keep 12 chunks east; you plant a war banner at the gold pillar beside it and starve it out.
tries: Read the book Charter: A First Hour in your inventory and follow it page by page. The longer guide is charter/TUTORIAL.md.

books.title: Charter: A First Hour
books.author: Charter
pages:
Welcome to Charter

Here factions hold land with keeps, and take land by starving a keep out, not by breaking its walls.

This book takes you through your first hour. Time runs 24 times fast for it.

1. Found a faction

Type in chat:

/charter found "My Hold" lordship

Then type /charter to open your faction page. Anything you may do shows as a link you can click.

2. Fill the treasury

Your faction pays: a keep is 64 diamonds, a war banner 256 cobblestone.

/charter vault deposit diamond 72
/charter vault deposit cobblestone 320

3. Raise your keep

Walk to the emerald pillar. Place the Nexus (a lodestone) on the ground near it.

The 3 by 3 chunks around it are now your keep. Hold the compass to see the borders.

4. Stock the granary

Place a chest in the Nexus's chunk: it is your granary. Put 40 bread in.

A keep under siege eats its granary. When it runs dry, the keep falls.

5. Claim land

Type /charter map. The yellow + squares touch your land: click one to claim it.

On your land, other factions may walk but not build, break or open anything.

6. Meet a rival

Brinewatch holds a keep 12 chunks east of you, the way the sun rises. Walk there. Try to break a block on their land: you cannot.

Walls do not take keeps here. Hunger does.

7. Plant a war banner

At the gold pillar, just short of their wall, place the War Banner on the ground.

It raises for 5 minutes under a smoke column. Till then, anyone may pull it down.

8. Feed the camp

Place the barrel next to the banner: it is the camp store. Put 48 bread in.

An empty camp besieges nobody. Cut off from home, it eats twice as fast.

9. The siege

Once the camp stands, Brinewatch is besieged and eats from its granary, which was nearly empty.

Stand in your camp's chunk: every attacker there makes them eat faster.

10. Assault

Below a quarter full, a keep is starving. Walk inside its walls: attackers in a starving keep make it eat four times as fast.

11. The fall

When their granary is empty the keep falls, and chat offers two choices:

Raze: the Nexus breaks and plunder spills out.
Occupy: you hold their keep a while.

What next

Defence is the other half: running food in through open sides, and wearing a camp down by standing beside it. Ask for the sally scenario.

The full guide is charter/TUTORIAL.md.
